newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade unchanged at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade unchanged at $64 - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 16 (Reuder) - Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with late Tuesday, USDA said. Confirmed - 4,900
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1260 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1160 lbs 64.00; pen mixed Commercial and Choice 1140 lb heifers and heiferettes 63.00.

Inquiry and demand good. Sales confirmed on 1,700 slaughter steers and 3,200 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 57,900 head confirmed including 20,400 head or about 36 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
